title: File:Tan Kah Kee, Lee Kong Chian, and Tan Lark Sye, 1946.png
depicts: Left to right: Tan Kah Kee (his father-in-law), Lee Kong Chian in a light suit and striped tie, and Tan Lark Sye, smiling indoors
artist: Unknown (Tan Kah Kee Memorial Museum collection)
note: Tagged PD-SG-photo (old Singapore photograph). Source linked on Commons is NAS ArchivesOnline record 9e88269a-1162-11e3-83d5-0050568939ad; NAS's own site says 'use and reproduction only with permission', so the PD claim rests on Singapore's copyright term for old photographs. Flag for the build agent. Grainy scan, but the only real photo of Lee beside Tan Kah Kee. Dated 'circa 1946'.

title: File:Lee Kong Chian, 1946.png
depicts: Lee Kong Chian, head and shoulders, in round glasses, a light suit and a pocket square
artist: Unknown (Tan Kah Kee Memorial Museum collection)
note: A crop of the trio photo above (same source and caveat). Low-res; good for a small inset or line trace, not a full page.

title: File:Statue of Dr Lee Kong Chian.jpg
depicts: Bronze statue of Lee Kong Chian outside the Kong Chian Administration Centre, Hwa Chong Institution (formerly The Chinese High School, which he chaired 1934-1955)
note: EXIF camera date 25 Oct 2008. The statue is a sculpture; Singapore has freedom of panorama for sculptures permanently in public places, and Commons hosts it on that basis.

title: File:Lee Kong Chian Statue Side View.jpg
depicts: The same Hwa Chong statue seen from the side
note: Commons date 8 Aug 2009 (EXIF 4 Sep 2009). Portrait orientation; good for a closing page.

title: File:HCI Lee Kong Chian.jpg
depicts: Lee Kong Chian statue at Hwa Chong Institution
note: Taken 26 Dec 2017. Small; duplicates the two Mh statue photos.

title: File:View of Middle Road in Singapore.jpg
depicts: View over Middle Road taken from inside the Central Public Library / Lee Kong Chian Reference Library building on Victoria Street
note: Taken 4 Aug 2023. It shows the view from the library, not the library itself; caption it that way. The free-library story is better told with a plate of the 1960 Stamford Road building.

title: File:Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum, NUS, Singapore.jpg
depicts: Exterior of the Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum at NUS, funded partly by the Lee Foundation
note: Taken 24 Jul 2015. Legacy page; it bears his name, which he refused in life (that irony is the caption).
